title: Double Sweet Asian Tofu & Veggies
subtitle: with Rice & Sriracha Mayo
description: Whip up this easy stir-fry for a delectable veggie dinner option! Enjoy sweet and sticky tofu chunks bursting with aromatic spices teamed with fluffy rice and tender veggies.

steps.text:
• In a medium saucepan, bring the water (for the rice) to boil.
• Add jasmine rice, stir, cover with a lid and reduce heat to low.
• Cook for 10 mins, then remove the pan from heat and keep covered until rice is tender and all the water is absorbed, 10 mins.

• Meanwhile, slice Asian greens into quarters lengthways.
• Thinly slice carrot into sticks.
• Cut Japanese tofu into 2cm chunks.
• In a medium bowl, combine sweet soy seasoning, honey and soy sauce and water (for the sauce)
• In a small bowl, combine sriracha (add less if you're sensitive to heat!) and mayonnaise.

• Add carrot, Asian greens and a splash of water to a microwave-safe bowl, then cover with a damp paper towel.
• Microwave veggies on high until just tender, 2-3 mins.
• Drain any excess liquid, then season with salt and pepper. Cover to keep warm.
• In a large frying pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil over medium-high heat. Cook tofu in batches, tossing until browned, 3-4 mins.
• And add honey-soy mixture and veggies, tossing until well combined, 1 min.

• Divide rice, tofu and veggies between bowls.
• Drizzle with sriracha mayo.
